steps: Begin each refinement with the previous final vote, same scope and every live deduction. Verify current hashes and identify genuinely changed assets so a successful narrow change cannot reset the whole-system score.
Use emil-design-eng's Before/After/Why format with matching-time baseline/current poses. Inspect the complete supplied offer sequence in both themes before selecting a favorable endpoint.

Build a native-size matrix at 96/128/160/240px for expressive full figures and the documented avatar sizes for the account mark. Judge the gain separately at each size and verify the result in the actual page composition.

Use apple-design spatial and typography principles for question/head relationships and responsive text hierarchy. Keep 320/390px and desktop checks, plus a separately recorded enlarged-text pass when actually performed. Retain the established font and outlined wordmark.

Use mobile-native to distinguish browser-width optical evidence from physical-phone behavior. Keep source checks, DOM/browser records, continuous perception, hardware/AT results and unprimed human responses in separate evidence fields.

Allow composition to differ between responsive layouts while requiring theme parity within each layout. Preserve contact intent, visitor return and the unchanged character geometry; tests corroborate those constraints but never substitute for rendered inspection.

When future engineering revisits small-size night paint or gesture clarity, compare against the adopted control on intended surrounds. Prefer application-size/framing guidance before changing paint, and preserve tiny anatomy.
exceptions: Functional UI timing ceilings do not truncate intentional character acting, and keyboard Play must remain able to play that content.
Compositor-only guidance does not authorize removing facial paths, tiny hands or character detail; a measured bottleneck must justify any rendering change.
Apple spatial/type principles do not imply Apple chrome or replacing the brand typeface.
A scrolling local study does not automatically need an app shell, global overscroll suppression or text-selection/zoom locks.
Reviewing installed skills does not invoke every opt-in implementation workflow. Root owns source and browser, and no new library or unrelated platform is needed.

Owned night-avatar stems remain weaker at 48px. Keep the day universal 32px mark and give night more room; the excluded night 32px probe is not another required use.
The phone portrait still requires vertical scrolling to expose the complete figure and transport. Attention correction does not remove that layout tradeoff.
No unfamiliar-human invitation, emotion comprehension, owner attribution, attachment or recall evidence. Authoring labels and explanatory copy prime the intended interpretation.
No continuous normal-speed motion appraisal by this reviewer. Source, tests, pose sheets and deterministic films do not certify felt timing, a flick-free wrist turn or live-device smoothness.
No physical-phone/GPU validation, spoken screen-reader evidence or native OS select-menu keyboard-commit verification. The new keyboard evidence covers desktop Play/Pause/Resume/range only.
